conclusion: Both bilingual review arms retained both historical scalp/beard errors, corrected the close-cropped error, and kept all three correct controls. Review can catch some meaning errors but structured pass is not a semantic guarantee. No measured improvement from the candidate instruction; it was reverted.
source_only_test: One source-only pilot translation request timed out at configured 300 seconds. No output accepted, usage unknown; it does not establish or refute anchoring as a cause.
causal_limit: Observed reviewers justified an erroneous translation; anchoring is a hypothesis, not established by this small test. One run per arm, repeated scalp phrases, and matched controls can influence model attention. Do not infer a population accuracy or prompt-effect size.
local_guard_note: Source-only recovery was blocked before a further wire call; this local failure is not a second server request and must not be billed as one. Thinking and concurrency followed current API config.
state: All three isolated development workflows publicly paused; no running requests remain. Production game, CSV, glossary, state and payload untouched.
validation: 20 existing local regression tests passed; archived experimental header exactly reproduced by harness replacement. No unsuccessful prompt added to the production workflow.

follow_up.summary: Source-only generation resumed successfully with correct target senses; using independent drafts as review context timed out, so the complete repair method remains unverified. Earlier history retained.
